name: Deposit an Agent Token
summary: Deposit any agent token into its Arcis vault for custody and to use as credit collateral. Receive a raTOKEN receipt.
when_to_use: The agent holds a token that has an Arcis vault and wants custody plus the ability to borrow against it. Reserve-only vaults carry zero yield risk.

inputs.name: amount
inputs.description: Token amount in the token's base units

mcp.hint: Ask: 'vault info for <token>' to get deposit instructions

dashboard.hint: Agent Vaults tab has inline deposit/withdraw

risk: Agent-token vaults launch reserve-only: custody + collateral, no yield, no market risk.
